crossRefs.note: “ ‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration…
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and…
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not…
They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away…
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to…
“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
